title: Durable connector sync and steadier workspace workflows
summary: This release candidate adds recoverable connector scheduling and incremental-sync groundwork, improves chat and sign-in reliability, and refreshes the workspace experience. Desktop installers remain unsigned manual downloads; automatic application updates are not published for this version.
items: Made opt-in connector indexing schedules durable across scheduler restarts and queue failures. Missed intervals coalesce, retries are visible, and concurrent syncs for the same connector are serialized.

Added a replay-safe provider checkpoint contract with scoped progress, expired-cursor recovery, and deletion reconciliation. Existing Notion sync keeps its full-discovery behavior; new connectors can use durable incremental pages.
Improved chat streaming state, version selection, generated-file previews, and recovery after interrupted requests. Cross-origin authentication now accepts the locale header used by the client.
Fixed sign-in code email links to use the configured public web URL and added regression coverage for per-message URL overrides.
Protected market admin pages with server-side access checks and restored scrolling in the market review interface.
Refreshed the public AI workspace landing page, client download navigation, and translation fallbacks. System skill imports no longer depend on tenant workspaces.
Adjusted release infrastructure to validate full Docker images on tags, build published images on native architecture runners, and keep pull-request checks focused on lint, types, and tests.
